name: Evidence Answer Experience
implementation: Deterministic presentation layer over the existing natural-language interpreter and deterministic retrieval engine; no parallel factual engine and no LLM dependency.
provenance: Tested through answer contract, content-derived database snapshot, interpretation version, methodology version and generation metadata.
quantitative: Calculation lineage and unit checks executed; quantitative mutations killed.
causal: Causal questions remain separate from observed change and are presented conservatively.
contradictions: Preserved rather than collapsed into a single winner.
corrections: Correction lineage remains inspectable where present.
as_of: Historical as_of semantics are preserved in the interpreted query and answer contract.
review_separation: Review is marked NOT_A_SOURCE and remains separate from evidence.
negative_knowledge: UNKNOWN, UNVERIFIED, DISPUTED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, INCOMPLETE, INCOMPARABLE, NO_MATCH and UNSUPPORTED remain distinct.
candidate_isolation: Only the three validated candidate IDs are permitted; Candidate 4 remains blocked.
limitations: Presentation remains limited to semantic routes already supported by the deterministic retrieval engine.
This phase does not claim unrestricted natural-language research or production readiness.
